prereq_intro: These are prerequisites required to obtain
svc_caste_validity_certificate_dept: Divisional Caste Scrutiny Committee, Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
svc_caste_validity_certificate_desc: A Caste Validity Certificate confirms the authenticity of an applicant's caste claim after detailed scrutiny by the Divisional Caste Certificate Scrutiny Committee. Required for professional degree admissions (CAP rounds), government service reservations, and local governance elections.
svc_caste_validity_certificate_where: Divisional Caste Certificate Scrutiny Committee Office or CCVIS Online Portal (bartievalidity.maharashtra.gov.in)
svc_caste_validity_certificate_mode: Online submission via CCVIS / BARTI portal with physical scrutiny submission
svc_caste_validity_certificate_fee: No government fee for students applying through recognized academic institutions; nominal processing fee per government resolution for employees/others
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_1: Gather all required documents listed in the checklist
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_2: Register and fill the application form on the CCVIS online portal
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_3: Upload self-attested scanned copies of required proofs
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_4: Submit physical dossier to the Divisional Caste Scrutiny Committee office
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_5: Collect acknowledgement receipt and track application status online
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_6: Attend scrutiny hearing if called by the committee
svc_caste_validity_certificate_step_7: Download digital certificate or collect physical certificate upon approval
svc_caste_certificate_dept: Revenue and Forest Department, Government of Maharashtra
svc_caste_certificate_desc: A Caste Certificate certifies the caste, tribe, or community of an individual citizen. Issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) / Deputy Collector / Tahsildar under the Revenue Department. Prerequisite for affirmative action benefits, scholarships, and the Caste Validity Certificate.
svc_caste_certificate_where: Aaple Sarkar Citizen Services Portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) or Tahsildar / Setu Kendra / CSC
svc_caste_certificate_mode: Online via Aaple Sarkar Portal or offline via Setu / Maha e-Seva Kendra
svc_caste_certificate_fee: Statutory fee of Rs. 33.60 via Aaple Sarkar portal under Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act
svc_caste_certificate_step_1: Login to Aaple Sarkar portal or visit the nearest Maha e-Seva Kendra / Setu office
svc_caste_certificate_step_2: Fill the application form for Caste Certificate under Revenue Services
svc_caste_certificate_step_3: Upload verified identity proof, address proof, and self-declaration affidavit
svc_caste_certificate_step_4: Pay statutory service charge online or at the counter
svc_caste_certificate_step_5: Collect system-generated acknowledgement receipt and application tracking number
svc_caste_certificate_step_6: Revenue enquiry and verification conducted by Talati / Circle Officer
svc_caste_certificate_step_7: Download digitally signed certificate from the portal once approved
svc_income_certificate_dept: Revenue and Forest Department, Government of Maharashtra
svc_income_certificate_desc: An Income Certificate certifies the annual family income of an applicant from all legitimate sources. Issued by the Executive Magistrate / Tahsildar for scholarships, fee concessions, EWS reservations, and public welfare schemes.
svc_income_certificate_where: Aaple Sarkar Portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) or Sub-Divisional / Tahsil Office Setu Kendra
svc_income_certificate_mode: Online via Aaple Sarkar or offline via Maha e-Seva Kendra
svc_income_certificate_fee: Statutory service fee of Rs. 33.60 via Aaple Sarkar portal
svc_income_certificate_step_1: Create an account or login to Aaple Sarkar Maharashtra portal
svc_income_certificate_step_2: Select Revenue Department and choose 'Income Certificate'
svc_income_certificate_step_3: Fill applicant details and declare total annual income across all family members
svc_income_certificate_step_4: Attach salary certificate, Form 16, or Talati income enquiry report
svc_income_certificate_step_5: Submit application and pay the prescribed fee online
svc_income_certificate_step_6: Receive SMS update with tracking ID upon submission
svc_income_certificate_step_7: Download verified digitally signed certificate within 15 working days
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_dept: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_desc: Government Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for eligible students belonging to reserved categories (SC, ST, VJNT, OBC, SBC) and economically weaker sections pursuing recognized post-secondary education. Provides full tuition waiver, exam fee reimbursement, and maintenance allowance.
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_fee: Free of cost. No application or registration fee on MahaDBT
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_1: Register on the MahaDBT portal using Aadhaar authentication
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_2: Fill profile information including personal, caste, and income details
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_3: Select the applicable Post-Matric Scholarship scheme for your category
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_4: Upload scanned copies of required documents and enter bank details
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_5: Submit the application and forward printout to college administration
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_6: College verifies and forwards application to District Welfare Officer
svc_sample_scholarship_scheme_step_7: Scholarship funds transferred directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank account via DBT

about_subtitle: An independent platform to help citizens prepare document checklists before applying for government services.
about_what_p1: DocumentReady is a community engagement project (AI & Data Science, UG 2026–27) that helps citizens understand what documents they need to gather before visiting a government office to apply for a service, certificate, or scheme.
about_what_p2: The core feature is a document readiness checker: you select a service, mark which documents you have and which are missing, and the system tells you exactly what to obtain first — with step-by-step guidance.
about_how_step1: Search for a service (e.g. "Caste Validity Certificate")
about_how_step2: The system shows a complete document checklist with all required, optional and conditional items
about_how_step3: Mark each item Available or Missing
about_how_step4: For missing documents, tap "How to obtain?" for a step-by-step guide — which may itself have prerequisites
about_how_step5: When all required documents are ready, click Verify Checklist to confirm
about_advisory_p1: All requirements and document checklists on DocumentReady are cross-verified against official state and central portals. Each service includes direct links to official portals (such as Aaple Sarkar, CCVIS/BARTI, UIDAI, and MahaDBT) and records the latest verification timestamp.
about_advisory_p2: This platform is an independent readiness support tool designed to guide citizens through prerequisites before visiting government offices.
about_data_li1: We never ask for Aadhaar numbers, document numbers, names, phone numbers or file uploads
about_data_li2: We only store your checklist status (Available/Missing per document) in your browser's localStorage
about_data_li3: No data is sent to or stored on any server
about_data_li4: Clearing your browser's localStorage removes all checklist data
about_tech_desc: Built with Python / Flask (backend), plain HTML5 + CSS3 + vanilla JavaScript (frontend), and SQLite database with JSON schema validation. No external CDN dependencies — works fully offline on localhost.
about_monitoring_intro: Our verification pipeline ensures document requirements remain accurate:
about_monitoring_li1: All service checklists are cross-referenced with official gazettes and department circulars
about_monitoring_li2: Issuing authorities, office modes, fees and timelines are validated against live government portals
about_monitoring_li3: Automated source monitoring tracks policy changes in real-time
about_monitoring_li4: Every verified update is timestamped and published to the public updates feed
updates_page_subtitle: Evidence-backed notifications from official Indian Central and Maharashtra State Government sources.
updates_empty_desc: All services are currently verified against active portals. As new official government notifications and policy circulars are published, updates will appear here in real time.
guide_aadhaar_what: Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) to residents. It serves as proof of identity and address across most government services.
guide_aadhaar_where: Aadhaar Enrolment / Update Centre — locate via uidai.gov.in. Some post offices and bank branches also serve as enrolment centres.
guide_affidavit_stamp_paper_what: An affidavit on stamp paper is a sworn statement made by the applicant, attested by a Notary Public or First Class Judicial Magistrate. For caste-related applications, it typically declares the applicant's caste, domicile, and other relevant facts.
guide_affidavit_stamp_paper_where: Licensed stamp vendors (near court premises or post offices), Notary Public offices (usually near district court), or First Class Judicial Magistrate offices.
guide_residence_proof_what: A residence proof (also called address proof) is any government-accepted document that shows your current residential address (utility bill, Aadhaar, ration card, or bank passbook).
guide_residence_proof_where: Most address proof documents are already in your possession (utility bills, ration card). A formal Domicile/Residence Certificate can be obtained from the Tehsil / Revenue office.
guide_caste_certificate_what: A Caste Certificate certifies the caste, tribe, or community of an individual citizen. It is issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) or Tahsildar under the State Revenue Department.
guide_caste_certificate_where: Aaple Sarkar Portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) or nearest Tahsil / Maha e-Seva Kendra / Setu office.
guide_school_leaving_certificate_what: A School Leaving Certificate (TC / LC) is an official educational record issued by a school or college verifying the applicant's date of birth, place of birth, and caste as per school admission register.
guide_school_leaving_certificate_where: Office of the Headmaster / Principal of the school or college last attended.
guide_relative_validity_record_what: A certified copy of a blood relative's (father, real paternal uncle, paternal aunt, or real brother/sister) caste validity order issued by a Scrutiny Committee.
guide_relative_validity_record_where: Obtain from the blood relative who possesses the original certificate or apply for a certified true copy from the concerned Divisional Caste Scrutiny Committee.
guide_admission_letter_what: An official allotment letter or admission receipt issued by a recognized university, college, or Centralized Admission Process (CAP) authority confirming your admission.
guide_admission_letter_where: College administration office, student section, or download from the centralized admission portal (CET Cell / University portal).
guide_income_proof_what: An Income Certificate or proof certifying the annual family income of the applicant from all sources, issued by the Tahsildar or Executive Magistrate.
guide_income_proof_where: Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) or local Tahsil office / Setu Kendra.
guide_self_declaration_form_what: A standardized self-declaration form prescribed under the Right to Public Services Act, affirming that all statements and attached documents are true and accurate.
guide_self_declaration_form_where: Download form template from Aaple Sarkar portal or collect physically from any Maha e-Seva Kendra / Tahsil counter.
guide_pre_1950_caste_proof_what: Historical documentary evidence of father, grandfather, or great-grandfather prior to the statutory cutoff date (1950 for SC/ST, 1967 for OBC/VJNT) showing recorded caste.
guide_pre_1950_caste_where: Ancestral school records, Zilla Parishad primary school registers, birth-death records at Tahsil/Gram Panchayat, or Land Revenue Record of Rights (7/12 extract).
guide_domicile_certificate_what: Certificate issued by the Executive Magistrate / Tahsildar proving continuous permanent residence in the state for at least 15 consecutive years.
guide_domicile_certificate_where: Aaple Sarkar portal or Sub-Divisional Officer / Tahsildar office / Maha e-Seva Kendra.
